title: Check if Array is a Rotation of Another
statement:
Given two arrays A and B each of length N, determine if B is a rotation of A.

B is a rotation of A if there exists a value K (0 <= K < N) such that rotating A left by K positions gives B.

Print `YES` if B is a rotation of A, otherwise print `NO`.

Hint: A+A (concatenation) contains all rotations. Check if B is a subarray of A+A using any O(N) method (KMP or naive).
inputFormat:
Line 1: a single integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers for array A.
Line 3: N space-separated integers for array B.

examples.explanation: Rotating A left by 2 gives [3,4,5,1,2] which equals B.
No rotation of A produces B.

n = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
